purpose: 创建存档时仅选择原创成年男性玩家形象；图片只用于视觉展示，不改变属性、玩法或 NPC 身份。

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original player appearance portrait for a modern Chinese urban cultivation RPG save-creation screen.
Primary request: one original adult male delivery rider, about 25 years old, ordinary human early in his journey.
Scene/backdrop: plain dark teal-gray painterly gradient with subtle brushed texture, no location.
Subject: calm warm expression, an original oval-to-rectangular face with a longer straight nose, relaxed thinner eyebrows, deep brown eyes, warm medium skin and neat black short hair with a modest side part. Clearly adult, lean natural proportions, gently closed mouth smile. He must have an independent face, never resemble an existing NPC or a celebrity.
Style/medium: polished semi-realistic digital painting, restrained visible brushwork, natural modern clothing, elegant urban fantasy RPG portrait. Matte ink-teal delivery jacket over a dark gray shirt, subtle narrow antique-bronze trim on shoulder and seam, no symbols or branding.
Composition/framing: exactly 3:4 upright portrait, one person from waist upward, eye-level, slight three-quarter stance, centered; full head with generous space above, both shoulders and elbows fully inside the image, small cropping margin. Both arms rest naturally at waist, hands simply resting on a plain closed dark gray motorcycle helmet held low in front of abdomen, no phone or extra props.
Lighting/mood: soft warm side light and restrained cool shadow, quiet dependable everyday rider.
Constraints: opaque nontransparent background; no writing, letters, badges, logo, watermarks, UI frame, magical effects, weapons, halos, extra people, childlike appearance, orange delivery jacket or messy spiky hair. Do not crop the head, shoulders, hands or helmet; do not add intricate finger gestures.
